<a id="page-look"></a>

## About this page

The theme, dark mode, row height, text size and animations.

#### How it works

The theme decides the colors, and Dark mode decides whether you see its light side or its dark one. Row height and Text size change how much fits in the window.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Style and theme.

The style, theme, dark mode, motion and vibration.

Style chooses between the plain Android look and Glass. The theme decides the colors, and Dark mode decides whether you see its light side or its dark one.

See also [Theme](/guide/settings/themes/), [Icons](/guide/settings/icons/), [Dark mode](/guide/settings/look/#setting-look), [Themes and colors](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-themes).

<a id="setting-ui-style"></a>

## Style

*Only in Android.*

Chooses between the plain Android look and Glass, the app's own style with blur, glow and larger animations.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Standard | Plain surfaces and the usual Android layout. The theme's colors, corners and font all apply. |
| Glass | Blur, glow and larger animations, with its own type and shapes. With the WM Pass theme or Device colors it is drawn in the accent you pick; any other theme lends it its colors. |

#### Limits

Blur needs Android 12 and the moving background needs Android 13. Below that, Glass keeps the same layout on gradients and solid color.

If WM Pass closes by itself within a few seconds of opening, twice in a row, the next launch goes back to the Standard style, theme, icons and list layout, and the unlock screen says why. Your vault and other settings stay as they were.

See also [Accent](/guide/settings/look/#setting-accent), [Theme](/guide/settings/look/#action-theme-choose), [Cards](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-settings-cards).

<a id="action-theme-choose"></a>

## Theme

Opens the list of themes. Choose one to use it at once.

#### How it works

A theme sets the colors for its light side and its dark side, the size of corners and the font. Dark mode chooses which side you see.

See also [Dark mode](/guide/settings/look/#setting-look), [Themes and colors](/guide/how-it-works/#feature-themes).

<a id="setting-look"></a>

## Dark mode

Whether WM Pass shows its theme's light colors or its dark ones.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| System | Follows your system's light or dark setting, and changes when it does. |
| Light | Always the light side of the theme. |
| Dark | Always the dark side of the theme. |
| Black | The dark side on a pure black background, with surfaces only a shade lighter. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

A theme made with only one side stays on that side whatever you choose here. The Theme page marks it "Light only" or "Dark only".

See also [Theme](/guide/settings/look/#action-theme-choose).

<a id="setting-accent"></a>

## Accent

*Only in Android.*

The color Glass is built around: its buttons, highlights, the glow behind the screen, and a tint in every surface.

#### How it works

The swatches appear under Dark mode while Style is Glass. They take effect with the WM Pass theme or Device colors; any other theme brings its own colors.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Emerald | Green to teal, the shield's own color. |
| Ocean | Sky blue to a deeper blue. |
| Iris | Violet to indigo. |
| Rose | Rose to pink. |
| Amber | Amber to orange. |
| Graphite | Cool grays, with no color to speak of. |

See also [Style](/guide/settings/look/#setting-ui-style), [Device colors](/guide/settings/themes/#action-theme-device).

<a id="setting-density"></a>

## Row height

*Only in the desktop app and the browser extension.*

The height of rows in the vault list, and the size of buttons, fields and other controls.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Compact | Shorter rows and smaller controls, so more fits in the window. |
| Comfortable | The middle size. |
| Spacious | Taller rows and larger controls, easier to hit. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Text size](/guide/settings/look/#setting-text-scale), [Layout](/guide/settings/list/#setting-layout).

<a id="setting-text-scale"></a>

## Text size

*Only in the desktop app and the browser extension.*

Makes all the text in WM Pass larger or smaller, from 85% to 130%, in steps of 5%.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Row height](/guide/settings/look/#setting-density).

<a id="setting-rich-motion"></a>

## Animations

Lets transitions and small animations play. Off makes them instant.

#### How it works

Motion in WM Pass answers something you did, or shows something really happening, such as a code changing.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| On | Messages rise into view, bars fill, and a wrong password shakes the shield. |
| Off | Changes happen at once, with nothing moving to show them. |

#### Limits

If your system is set to reduce motion, transitions are already instant, whatever this says.

#### On Android

With the system's animations turned off, WM Pass stills its motion as well, whatever this says.

See also [Style](/guide/settings/look/#setting-ui-style).

<a id="setting-haptics"></a>

## Vibration

*Only in Android.*

A small tap you can feel when something happens.
